name: Cake Pan Goop
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Vegetable oil or another neutral-flavored oil

steps: Stir together the oil and shortening. This can be done with a spoon, a whisk, or an electric mixer.
Add the flour and stir until mostly smooth. Don't worry about trying to get every little lump out.

When a recipe says to prepare the cake pan by greasing and flouring it, or by spraying it with a cooking spray containing flour, instead use a brush to spread a thin layer of cake goop on the bottom and sides of the pan. If the pan has intricate details, be sure that the goop has gotten into the crevices. Then, pour in the cake batter, and bake as usual.
